catalog_quirks.body: BlazeAPI Free includes 200,000 shared tokens per day, with email verification. This is a daily allowance, not monthly credits or a per-model grant. All eight listed routes returned valid, matching-model text completions on October 5, 2026 with blaze_plan=free and blaze_billing=plan. Use https://api.blazeapi.org/paid/v1 even on Free. Provider metadata advertises a 128,000-token context and 16,000-token maximum output for these routes; tools, vision and streaming were not verified in this audit. Optional paid balances and upgrades are outside this allowance. See https://blazeapi.org/pricing.
